label: preparing
what: Innkeeper, freight, and builder are jointly arranging an evening gathering in the town hall great hall at 18:00, with substantial bread refreshments (an original 120 loaves and 80 additional loaves). Baker is supplying bread and secretary is arranging my appointment and escort. I have been told it concerns civic hospitality and community gatherings, but the actual occasion and detailed agenda remain undisclosed; there is insufficient evidence to identify a more specific purpose.
